stateNote: Prefry potatoes for about 7–12 minutes in 130–186 °C (275°F–365°F) fat to cook the inner part without burning the outside. When the fries are added to the oil, the oil at first cools quickly and is kept at low temperature to prevent the potatoes from burning. The fries should stay a pale beige to yellow color and not be too dry.
